value.notes: Turn 1: first probe. Testing basic step, dash, dash recharge countdown, pause freezing timers, resume with Enter. Watch HUD vs state, dash cooldown (should be 6 after dash, shows 5 after first running tick), and whether timer/cooldown freeze while paused.

Turn 2 plan: test same-tick input rules. Run A: right+down (expect only down move to (1,2)), pause+left (expect nothing moves, paused), enter (resume), left+right (expect only right, bump into wall at (2,2)). Then probe spikes at (3,3) via dash/steps, lever at (1,8) and gates, locked doors, timer expiry, pause during dash recharge, Restart, game over, exit flow. Map row 2 is '#.##@##' so (1,2) is floor.

Suspect: same-tick movement keys both execute (violates one-move-per-tick, last key wins). Run2 #0 right+down ended at (2,1) with events move,bump (right executed, down bumped) instead of expected down to (1,2). Confirming with down+right from start. Then minimise and probe spikes/lever/pause-during-dash after.

Hypothesis: for two movement keys pressed in the same tick, the FIRST pressed key wins, not the last. Run 2 (right+down) moved right to (2,1); run 3 (down+right) moved down to (1,2). Design says only the last key counts, so down+right should go to (2,1). Also 'bump' appears for the losing key, so the losing key is still being processed. Next: confirm with a one-token run (down+right) to see if the player is at (1,2), then probe left+right / up+down and dash combos to see if the same rule applies. Afterwards, explore spikes, lever, pause during dash, dialogs, and the timer/time bonus.

reports.title: Two movement keys in the same tick: first pressed key wins instead of last
reports.observed: down+right from start (1,1) ends at (1,2) (down executed, right bumped). right+down ends at (2,1) (right executed, down bumped).
reports.expected: Only the last movement key in a tick counts, so down+right should move right to (2,1) and right+down should move down to (1,2).

value.notes: Confirmed the same-tick input bug. With seed 12345, down+right from (1,1) ends at (1,2), so the first key (down) won. The design says the last key pressed counts, so it should end at (2,1). Run 2 (right+down) went to (2,1), which is consistent with first-key-wins. The single token 'down+right' is already minimal. Not yet probed: dash and spikes, lever and gates, pause during dash, dialogs and buttons, the timer and time bonus, and score caps. I stopped here to save budget.

reports.title: Two movement keys in the same tick: first pressed key wins instead of last
reports.observed: Seed 12345, one tick with down+right from the start (1,1): the player ends at (1,2), so the down key was applied and the right key was ignored. In run 2, right+down also moved right to (2,1), so the earlier key wins in both orders.
reports.expected: Design section 2/3: of the movement keys pressed in a tick, only the last one counts. down+right should move the player right to (2,1).
